newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: U.S. Cuba envoy to hold talks with Dutch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Cuba envoy to hold talks with Dutch.

text.p: U.S. special envoy on Cuba Stuart Eizenstat will visit The Hague later this month for talks expected to cover a dispute between the United States and Europe over investment in Cuba, the Dutch government said on Thursday.

EU foreign ministers decided on Tuesday to lodge a complaint with the World Trade Organisation (WTO) against Washington's controversial Helms-Burton Act restricting foreign investment in Cuba and providing for penalties against overseas companies.
"Mr Eizenstat is scheduled to meet...(Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo) at the end of October," spokesman Peter Mollema said.
"The WTO hearing will undoubtedly be on the agenda given that it will run during the Dutch presidency of the European Union (from January 1997)," Mollema said.
Earlier trips by Eizenstat, U.S. Under-Secretary for Commerce, to try to win European support for coordinated action against Cuba have met with little success.
